messages.subject: NIMBLE in-person short course, June 1-3, Lisbon, Portugal
messages.subject_clean: NIMBLE in-person short course, June 1-3, Lisbon, Portugal
messages.body_plain:
This is a reminder that we'll be holding an in-person workshop on NIMBLE, June 1-3, 2022, in Lisbon, Portugal, sponsored by the Centro de Estatística e Aplicações at the Universidade Lisboa (CEAUL).

There are still some open seats available, and I hear that early June is a nice time of year in Lisbon.

More details and registration are available at the workshop website <https://nimbleworkshop.weebly.com/>. No previous NIMBLE experience is required, but the workshop will assume some familiarity with hierarchical models, Markov chain Monte Carlo (MCMC), and R.

-Chris
